_comment: Ascension perk requirements the build cannot derive from script.
Everything else is read from the files: a technology's own `potential`,
scripted triggers that wrap `has_ascension_perk`, and perks that grant a
technology via `add_research_option`. Some technologies are handed over
through a chain the build does not follow — a perk enables a special
project, and the project grants the technology on completion — so they
are listed here instead.
Format: technology id -> list of ascension perk ids. Dependent
technologies inherit the requirement automatically; list only the entry
point of a chain.
These appear in data/perk-audit.json with reason "manual", so they can
be told apart from requirements found in script.
conditionLabels names non-perk routes that appear as alternatives, so the viewer can say "Mechromancy or Genetic Ascension".
perkNames supplies a display name for perks the vanilla extraction has not captured; names found in the game files always win.
"names" supplies a perk's display name when the extractor could not capture it from the game's localisation. Names found in the game always win; these are only a fallback.
"conditionLabels" renames a condition that appears as an alternative to
a perk. Keys may be a bare condition ("has_genetically_ascended") or a
condition and value ("has_country_flag:blokkat_bureau_unlocked").
The cosmogenesis technologies are handed out by a scripted effect when
the crisis reaches a level, not by the perk directly. Only technologies
that come from nowhere else are listed: Dark Matter Propulsion and the
Enigmatic Decoder are granted at the same moment but are researchable
by other means, so they are not marked.
